models.label: Claude Fable 5
models.notes: cacheWrite is the 1 hour cache rate, which is what Claude Code sessions use. cacheWrite5m is the 5 minute rate.

models.label: Claude Opus 5
models.notes: cacheWrite is the 1 hour cache rate. Fast mode costs more (10.00 in, 50.00 out) and is not counted here.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: cacheWrite is the 1 hour cache rate.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5
models.notes: The 2.00 and 10.00 launch prices are now the standard prices; the rise to 3.00 and 15.00 planned for 2026-09-01 was cancelled.

models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: The only model here with a 200,000 token window, so its skill listing budget is five times smaller.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.notes: OpenAI charges nothing extra to put something in the cache, so cacheWrite is null. These prices cover prompts up to 272,000 tokens; longer ones cost 10.00 in, 1.00 cached, 45.00 out.

models.label: GPT-5.4
models.notes: No separate charge for writing to the cache. These prices cover prompts up to 272,000 tokens; longer ones cost 5.00 in, 0.50 cached, 22.50 out.

models.label: Gemini 3.1 Pro (preview)
models.notes: Google bills cache storage by the hour (4.50 per 1M tokens per hour) instead of charging once to write, so cacheWrite is null. These prices cover prompts up to 200,000 tokens; longer ones cost 4.00 in, 0.40 cached, 18.00 out.

models.label: Gemini 3.7 Flash
models.notes: Introductory price through 2026-12-31; on 2027-01-01 it doubles to 1.50 in, 0.15 cached, 7.50 out. Cache storage is billed by the hour (0.50 per 1M tokens per hour) instead of once on write.
